entries.title: EVOTS: Evolutionary Transformer Search for Time Series Forecasting
entries.note: evolutionary NAS over attention/FFN/projection genome; evolved task-adaptive transformer-likes beat fixed baselines. Grounds the body-VARIANT path: search architectures, not weights.

entries.title: Do Stationarity Transformations Actually Improve Time Series Forecasts? A Controlled Experimental Evaluation
entries.note: 35k-eval controlled study: signal-preserving transforms (detrending matched to structure) help; indiscriminate differencing hurts; stationarity only weakly tied to accuracy. Grounds a feature-pipeline probe: our [0,1] squash-all is indiscriminate.

entries.title: Superposition Is Not Necessary: A Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis of Transformer Representations for Time Series Forecasting
entries.note: narrow single-layer matches deep configs; FFN reps sparse without superposition; linear competitiveness stands. Converges with B2/m5g: the transformer adds nothing over linear on noisy series.
